name: Supercell
why: A few hit games played by millions, built by small teams: software scales without adding people.
hint: Makes mobile games with famously small teams.

name: Remedy Entertainment
why: Big-budget games take years of work from large teams before they earn anything.
hint: Makes story-driven console games that take years to build.

name: Kesko
why: Huge sales volume, but retail runs on people in stores, warehouses and logistics.
hint: Runs grocery, building and car retail across Finland.

name: Tokmanni
why: Low-price retail: high volumes, thin margins and lots of in-store staff.
hint: Discount retailer with hundreds of stores.

name: Nokia
why: Global network equipment business with large engineering and service teams.
hint: Builds the networks your phone connects to.

name: Elisa
why: Subscription revenue on existing networks: each customer adds little extra work.

name: Kone
why: Elevator maintenance is a huge, steady business, and it needs a technician at every site.
hint: Elevators and escalators, plus the people who service them.

name: Wärtsilä
why: Heavy engineering plus a long tail of service work across the world's ports.
hint: Engines and power systems for ships and power plants.

name: Valmet
why: Builds large process lines and services them for decades.
hint: Machinery for pulp, paper and energy plants.

name: Neste
why: Refining moves enormous volumes through automated plants run by relatively few people.

name: Fortum
why: Power plants are capital-heavy but need few people per euro of electricity sold.
hint: Produces and sells electricity in the Nordics.

name: UPM
why: Large automated mills, but forestry and logistics still need many hands.

name: Huhtamäki
why: Many factories worldwide making high volumes of low-price items.

name: Outokumpu
why: Steel prices make revenue big, and modern mills are highly automated.

name: Fiskars
why: Many brands and product lines, each with its own design, sales and supply chain.

name: Marimekko
why: Strong brand and premium prices, but own stores and design work need people.

name: Harvia
why: Niche global leader: focused products sold through dealers.

name: Orion
why: Patented medicines earn a lot per unit, but research and production need specialists.

name: Finnair
why: Airlines need crews, ground staff and maintenance for every flight.

name: Fazer
why: Food production and bakeries: high volumes, many factories and lots of shift work.

name: Valio
why: Large dairy plants process farmers' milk at scale with automated lines.
hint: Milk, cheese and the Oltermanni brand.
